assumptions.text: Aircraft-reported navigation accuracy falls because GNSS is jammed or spoofed, not because of avionics faults, when several aircraft types show it together.

test.rule: Validation days in docs/validation/ (20 days); NF-IND-7 flags single-source cases

assumptions.text: adsb.lol feeder coverage over an area does not change sharply from week to week.

test.rule: NF-IND-8: aircraft count within 30% of its 28-day median

assumptions.text: A fall in the severe share means interference eased.

test.rule: Read position loss before a fall: jammed aircraft can stop reporting position altogether

assumptions.note: Known to fail where position loss is high (docs/validation/position-loss.md). Falls are reported with that caveat.

assumptions.text: ESA's scintillation nowcast is current when it is read.

test.rule: nowcast valid time within 3 hours of the build (board.py already applies this)
